project: BufferBloat Detection and Queue Management Optimization Using NS-3

textbook_bloat.name: Textbook DropTail BufferBloat
textbook_bloat.description: Large 100-packet FIFO queue on a 5 Mbps bottleneck link. Causes severe queue latency buildup (BufferBloat) under high TCP load.

codel_mitigation.name: CoDel Controlled Delay AQM
codel_mitigation.description: CoDel automatically manages queue delay with a 5ms target and 100ms interval, dropping packets only when standing queue persists.

fq_codel_fairness.name: FQ-CoDel Fair Queueing + CoDel
fq_codel_fairness.description: Combines CoDel with flow isolation. Heavy bulk flows are queued separately while low-rate interactive ping probes experience zero bloat.

red_aqm.name: RED (Random Early Detection)
red_aqm.description: Classic active queue management that drops packets probabilistically based on average queue size (minTh=20p, maxTh=80p).

small_buffer.name: Small FIFO Buffer (No Bloat, High Drop)
small_buffer.description: Small 15-packet FIFO buffer. Prevents BufferBloat latency buildup but causes higher packet drop rates and potential TCP throughput collapse.
